title: Ahaz
lead: King of Judah in the 730s and 720s BC, son of Jotham and father of Hezekiah. When Aram and Israel attacked Jerusalem, he turned down Isaiah's call to trust the LORD and the offer of a sign, and paid Tiglath-pileser of Assyria to rescue him instead (Isaiah 7; 2 Kings 16). Kings and Chronicles remember him as one of Judah's worst kings.
